user.title: EnOcean gateway
user.description: Select the serial port of the EnOcean USB transceiver. Prefer the stable /dev/serial/by-id path.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EnOcean gateway
reconfigure.description: Select the new serial port of the EnOcean USB transceiver.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open the serial port or the transceiver did not answer. Check the path and make sure no other add-on or process owns the port.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one EnOcean gateway is supported.

inbox.title: Radio inbox
inbox.description: Senders heard recently that are not configured yet. A profile is only shown when the device declared it in a teach-in telegram; otherwise select the EEP yourself on the next screen.

add_manual.title: Add a device
add_manual.description: Enter the exact 8-digit radio address (leading zeroes matter) and the device EEP. A passive transmitter does not need to be re-paired.

actuator.title: Actuator settings
actuator.description: Device {address}. The sender ID is the controller identity the actuator already knows; it is proposed from the transceiver Base ID ({base_id}) and must stay within Base ID +127. It is never allocated automatically. Radio channel 0 is Channel 1 on the device.

remove_confirm.title: Remove device
remove_confirm.description: Remove {name} ({address})? Its entities will be deleted. The physical device is not touched and no teach-out is sent.

import_devices.title: Import an inventory
import_devices.description:
Paste a JSON export document. Format: a top-level "version": 1 and a "devices" list; each device has "address" (8 hex digits), "eep", "name", and for actuators "sender_id" and "channel". The whole file is validated first; nothing is saved if any record is invalid.

{detail}

import_confirm.title: Import preview

export_devices.title: Export backup
export_devices.description:
Copy this document and store it safely. It contains recovery configuration and no secrets.

```
{export_json}
```

error.invalid_address: Enter exactly 8 hexadecimal digits, keeping leading zeroes.
error.invalid_sender: Enter the sender ID as 8 hexadecimal digits.
error.sender_out_of_range: The sender ID must be within the transceiver Base ID range (Base ID to Base ID +127).
error.import_invalid: The document was rejected; nothing was saved. See the details above.
error.not_eurid: This is a sender/base address, not a device address (device EURIDs end at FF7FFFFF).

abort.inbox_empty: No unconfigured senders have been heard yet.

serial_disconnected.title: EnOcean transceiver disconnected
serial_disconnected.description: The serial connection to {port} was lost. The integration keeps retrying automatically. Check that the USB transceiver is plugged in and that no other process has taken the port.

not_connected.message: The EnOcean gateway is not connected.

invalid_sender.message: Sender ID {sender_id} is outside the transceiver Base ID range; command not sent.

command_not_acknowledged.message: The transceiver did not acknowledge the command for {address}.
